checks.details: VCS scheme methods (getVcsScheme/setVcsScheme) follow existing pattern from jjInstallIgnored methods without significant code duplication. The pattern of reading/writing JSON config is consistent and appropriate.

Both scripts share similar VCS scheme handling logic, but duplication is acceptable as they operate on different worktree types (specs vs bugs) with different path patterns and branch naming conventions.
Merge scripts share similar VCS scheme reading and branching logic. The duplication is justified due to different JSON source files (spec.json vs bug.json) and different commit message formats.
VcsScheme type is defined once in electron-sdd-manager/src/shared/types/worktree.ts and imported throughout. Type guard functions (isValidVcsScheme, getWorktreeVcsScheme) are also centralized here.

Project default VCS scheme is stored in sdd-orchestrator.json (SSOT for project settings). Per-worktree VCS scheme is stored in spec.json/bug.json worktree field. This separation follows the design document's SSOT principle.
Component follows simple dropdown pattern with clear responsibilities. State management is straightforward with local state for UI interactions. Error handling is clear and user-friendly.
Implementation is focused on the required functionality (git/jj selection) without unnecessary features. Non-goals (spec-level override, jj colocated mode) are explicitly excluded per design.
VcsSchemeSelector is imported and used in ProjectSettingsDialog.tsx. All exports (VcsSchemeSelector, VcsSchemeSelectorProps) are consumed.
VcsScheme type, isValidVcsScheme, and getWorktreeVcsScheme are imported in multiple files including settingsFileManager.ts, worktreeImplHandlers.ts, bugWorkflowService.ts, and test files.
VCS_SCHEME_GET and VCS_SCHEME_SET channels are registered in handlers.ts and exposed via preload API. They are consumed by VcsSchemeSelector and ProjectSettingsDialog.
